name: MIT-BIH Atrial Fibrillation Database
description: The MIT-BIH Atrial Fibrillation Database is a classic benchmark developed by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Beth Israel Hospital Arrhythmia Laboratory for developing and evaluating algorithms that detect atrial fibrillation (AF) and flutter. The collection contains 25 ten-hour continuous two-channel ECG recordings sampled at 250 Hz with 12-bit resolution, acquired from 25 subjects with predominantly paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. It includes expert beat annotations and precise rhythm episode state markers denoting the exact transitions between normal sinus rhythm, atrial fibrillation, atrial flutter, and junctional rhythm.
